name: ATOMS
texts: Allows you to navigate the Steam Que on store pages Via the arrow keys.
Automatically ignores certain games (tags/banned keywords can be set in 'config.js'; see 'js/configDefaults.js' for the full list)
Enables Use of System Accent Color from Mill' settings.
Enables semi-transparent icons for uninstall games in the game-grid.
Show the optional ATOMS on/off comparison button. Turning this option off restores the theme and removes the button.
